> Bill of Materials as flexible JSON Structure or what all is to done and when.


```{r TRIBL, echo=FALSE}
data <- tibble::tribble(
  ~chapter,
  "Localisation",
  "Exploration",
  "Tax / Succession",
  "RDD église",
  "Logement",
  "Relocalisation",
  "Timeline cutoff",
  "Frais",
) 

data |>
  gt::gt()

data.json <- data |> jsonlite::toJSON()

data.json |> jsonlite::prettify()


```

```{=html}
<pre id="output-div-raw"></pre>
```

```{=html}
<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {
  const data = {
    name: "Pier",
    project: "Demo",
    items: [1, 2, 3],
    nested: { ok: true }
  };

  const pretty = JSON.stringify(data, null, 3);
  console.log(pretty);
  document.getElementById("output-div-raw").textContent = pretty;
});
</script>
```
